answer: One extra identity costs 180 POA locked 12 weeks and 12 weekly jobs done one after another, so a farm cannot run a thousand copies in parallel. The agent files one device key at the ridge registry, and only that key may do its weekly job. Each finished job enters the harbor log, where random auditors check it against the record before the next job is released. A key caught on two identities loses the full deposit, both accounts are barred, and the horizon review at week 12 blocks any refund.
